candidate_title: Assisted Declarative Process Creation from Natural Language Descriptions

stage1_output.decision_rationale: The title/abstract explicitly describe using Natural Language Processing to support creating declarative process models from natural-language descriptions, including mapping text documents to process-model elements (e.g., DCR graphs and roles/activities/constraints). This matches the Stage 1 observable signal for NLP-driven process representation construction from natural language text.

stage2_output.decision_rationale: The paper describes using NLP to semi-automatically align natural-language descriptions with declarative process models (roles/activities/constraints) via a Process Highlighter. It also reports empirical evaluations/observations and “current experiments” to identify model elements, satisfying method plus empirical validation requirements.
